content.comment_body: Hello, Is there an alternative way to shut down the [product_name] device to a safe status, apart from the usual method using the Web Based Management and its physical power button? We need to turn off the power supply during extended breaks like holidays. Any suggestions for other options would be appreciated. Thank you.
From what I know, the only other method is using the SET button on the device itself. Please refer to the attachment for details.
Hello, Thanks for your prompt response and for confirming that these are the only available options besides using Web Based Management.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for additional ways to safely shut down the [product_name] device beyond the standard web interface and power button, especially for planned power-offs like holidays. Responses indicate that only the SET button offers another method, highlighting limited shutdown options and no software-based or remote alternatives, which may restrict operational flexibility for some users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate more flexible or automated shutdown features for the [product_name] device, preferably beyond just the physical and web-based controls.
